names.form: Όσιος Άνθιμος ο Βαγιάνος ο εν Χίω

attestations.note: Not on the Moscow Patriarchate’s list for 3 September (Julian) — days.pravoslavie.ru, read 2026-08-23; no other day checked.
Not on doxologia.ro’s list for 3 septembrie (checked 2026-08-23); no other day checked.

feast.note: The translation of his relics, as saint.gr keeps it on 3 September; his feast is 15 February.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 3 Σεπτεμβρίου — «Ανακομιδή Ιερών λειψάνων του Οσίου Άνθιμου του Βαγιάνου του εν Χίω»

attestations.note: Not on the Православни подсетник’s calendar line for 16.09.2026 (3. септембар ст. ст.), nor in its Ohrid Prologue for that day (pravoslavno.rs, checked 2026-08-23).

birth.note: Born 1 July 1869 at Livadia on Chios, azbyka.ru.

death.note: Died 15 February 1960, azbyka.ru; relics found 3 September 1965, canonised 14 August 1992.
